# Hover

> Hover is the simplest way to send money across borders. Sign in with Google, Apple or email, choose an amount, and your money arrives in seconds.

Hover is available on Google Play for Android (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=money.hover.app) and on iPhone through TestFlight. Sign in with Google, Apple, or email.

## Key facts

- No password: sign in with Google, Apple, or a one-time email code.
- Android: Google Play. iPhone: TestFlight.
- Transfers are typically delivered in seconds, any time of day, including weekends and holidays.
- Built for cross-border (international) payments; domestic transfers work too.
- Every transfer's fee is shown before you confirm — no hidden charges.
- Only the sender can approve a payment, and every transfer is protected end to end so it cannot be altered, reused, or redirected.
